text:
lisa.newhire: Hi folks — quick question about 401k options. I have a balance at my previous employer (~$18k). Do we let people roll that into Redwood's plan or keep it where it is? Also, when does company match start for new hires and is there a vesting schedule?

sarah.hr: Welcome! You can roll funds into Redwood's 401(k) or leave them with the prior provider. Pro: rolling consolidates accounts; con: check investment options/fees. We accept rollovers into our plan.

lisa.newhire: Thanks — any paperwork or vendor name I should give the old plan admin?

mike.payroll: Vendor is BrightPath Retirement (our recordkeeper). For in-plan rollovers we need a completed rollover form plus a recent statement from your old plan. If you want, send both to benefits@redwood.com and we’ll initiate. Note payroll processing/cutoffs below. 

mike.payroll: ``Payroll notes: enroll/changes submitted by Fri 5pm PT for the next pay period. First eligible contribution shows on the next paycheck after enrollment processes (~1 pay cycle). Rollovers are separate and processed by BrightPath — typically 2–4 weeks.``

jordan.finance: Matching: Redwood matches 50% of your contributions up to 6% of pay (so max company contribution = 3% of pay). Vesting is graded: 25% per year over 4 years. Match is calculated each pay period and deposited to your 401(k) account.

lisa.newhire: Good to know on vesting. If I roll in, does that affect vesting?

sarah.hr: Rollover balances are fully vested by default (i.e., money you roll in is your money). Only employer contributions subject to our vesting schedule.

lisa.newhire: Great. One more: I'm turning 50 this year — can I do catch-up contributions immediately?

mike.payroll: Yes, catch-up contributions (age 50+) are allowed once you enroll. Make sure to select the catch-up box in the BrightPath enrollment portal or tell payroll. We process catch-ups same as regular pre-tax deferrals.

lisa.newhire: What about HSA vs FSA? Which one do we offer and can I contribute pre-tax through payroll right away?

benefits-bot: Redwood offers an HSA for employees enrolled in our qualifying HDHP and a limited-purpose FSA for dental/vision if you opt into the HSA. HSA contributions are pre-tax via payroll. Check eligibility at: https://benefits.redwood.com/hsa-fsa

sarah.hr: Quick checklist for you: 1) Enroll in 401(k) via BrightPath (or email rollover docs) 2) Select contribution % and enable catch-up if eligible 3) Enroll in HDHP to get HSA eligibility 4) Send rollover form + prior statement to benefits@redwood.com if rolling over.

lisa.newhire: Thanks everyone! I’ll send the rollover docs today. :thumbsup:

mike.payroll: Ping us if you hit any snags. If you want, I can review the rollover form before submission.

sarah.hr: Happy to help with the vendor follow-up.

benefits-bot: Automated note: BrightPath processing times may vary. Expect follow-up emails from BrightPath within 1–2 business days after benefits@redwood.com submits the request.
